source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) under 9.2 as printed (PDF 127, printed 123).

blocks.text: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) is a security method that requires two forms of verification before allowing access to an account. For example, after entering a password, the user may receive a code on their phone or email to confirm their identity. This extra step makes it much harder for hackers to break in.
